description:
The store owner wants to allow customers to add gift options to their orders. You need to add two custom fields to the 'Default' Order type in Drupal Commerce.

1. Navigate to the 'Default' order type configuration.
2. Add a new field for 'Gift Message':
   - Label: 'Gift Message'
   - Field Type: Text (plain, long)
   - Machine Name: 'field_gift_message'
   - This field should NOT be required.

3. Add a new field for 'Gift Wrap Requested':
   - Label: 'Gift Wrap Requested'
   - Field Type: Boolean
   - Machine Name: 'field_gift_wrap'
   - This field should NOT be required.

4. Ensure both fields are enabled in the 'Manage form display' tab so they appear on the order admin form.

Start by navigating to Commerce > Configuration > Order types > Default > Manage fields.
